join.title: Set up your practice on UpSpeech
join.password_intro: Enter the password you were given at the event.
join.wrong_password: That password is not right. Try again.
join.expired: Your signup timed out. Enter the password again.
join.closed_body: Check the link with the person who shared it.
join.practice_name_required: Enter a name for your practice
join.kind_stuttering_help: Ready-made paths and exercises for stuttering.
join.kind_general_help: Any condition, with the steps you write.
join.hero_title: This is what your patient does between sessions.
join.hero_body: You write a short step. Your patient records it on their phone when it suits them. You listen, reply and adjust their path.
join.phone_caption: The first step a patient receives, written by the person who works with them.
join.example_instruction: Tell me how your week went.
join.week_write_body: A 30-second recording, a written answer or a task in daily life.
join.week_record_title: Your patient records on their phone
join.week_record_body: When it suits them. Children practise with a family member or caregiver.
join.week_reply_body: The patients who need you come first: who sent work and who stopped practising.
join.week_report_body: You record or upload the session. You get a draft and edit it yourself.
join.trial_title_plain: Try it free. And after that?
join.trial_open: Everything in your practice is open: patients, paths, reports.
join.trial_locked: Your practice is locked when you sign in. Your data and your patients' data are kept.
join.trial_continue: To carry on, write to <mail>{{email}}</mail> and we will talk to you about a plan for your practice.
join.form_intro: Once you are in, you invite your first patient and write their first step. It takes a few minutes.
join.footer: UpSpeech, practice and feedback between therapist and patient
